warning.titlePre: Jaguar XJR AJ133S Timing Chain Tensioner & Water Pump Issue
paragraphs: If your XJR is an X351-generation model (2009–2019) with the AJ133S 5.0-litre supercharged V8 – that engine shares the confirmed timing chain tensioner and guide design flaw found across several JLR models, and was the subject of a US class-action lawsuit. The hardened steel tensioner piston can wear the aluminium guide button over time, and the water pump may suffer bearing/seal failure, sometimes under 20,000 miles. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides and water pump as standard on every AJ133S rebuild.
Earlier XJR generations – X300 with the AJ16 supercharged inline-six, and X308/X350 with the earlier AJ-V8 supercharged units – use different engine designs and do not share this specific issue.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (kmotors.co.uk, rrsport.co.uk lawsuit reference, TopSpeed), per VRF-jaguar-xj.md. AJ16 and AJ-V8 supercharged explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF.
